map.缺铁/巨幼/溶血（实验室鉴别） 使用指南: Iron Deficiency / Megaloblastic / Hemolysis (Lab Differential) User Guide
map.贫血实验室鉴别在线工具，输入红细胞参数与指标辅助区分缺铁性、巨幼细胞性与溶血性贫: An online anemia laboratory differential tool that takes red cell parameters and indicators to help distinguish iron deficiency, megaloblastic and hemolytic anemia for clinical reference; pure front-end.
map.贫血患者按 MCV、铁代谢、网织红细胞、胆红素/结合珠蛋白定类型: Classify anemia by MCV, iron metabolism, reticulocytes, bilirubin and haptoglobin
map.小细胞看缺铁（低 MCV、低铁蛋白、高 TIBC）vs 地贫（RDW 正常）: In small cells, check iron deficiency (low MCV, low ferritin, high TIBC) against thalassemia (normal RDW)
map.大细胞+高 LDH+高网织提示溶血或巨幼，进一步查 B12/叶酸: Large cells plus high LDH plus high reticulocytes point to hemolysis or megaloblastic anemia; check B12 and folate next
map.：鉴别路径：①MCV 分小细胞/正细胞/大细胞；②小细胞查铁蛋白（<15–30: Differential path: 1) MCV splits small / normocytic / macrocytic cells; 2) for small cells check ferritin (<15-30 microg/L supports iron deficiency) and hemoglobin electrophoresis (thalassemia); 3) for macrocytic check vitamin B12 (<148 pmol/L), folate (<7 nmol/L) and reticulocytes; 4) for hemolysis check reticulocytes > 2%, LDH > 400, bilirubin > 20, haptoglobin < 0.3 and Coombs. The three together localize iron deficiency / megaloblastic / hemolytic.
map.：例（MCV=72 fL、铁蛋白=8 μg/L、TIBC=75 μmol/L、网: Example (MCV=72 fL, ferritin=8 microg/L, TIBC=75 umol/L, reticulocytes=1.2%, LDH=250, bilirubin=12, haptoglobin=1.0): small cells plus low ferritin plus TSAT=8% (low) -> iron deficiency anemia; no evidence of hemolysis (LDH, bilirubin and haptoglobin normal) and no megaloblastosis (MCV not increased). Confirming iron deficiency requires iron replacement and investigating the cause (menstrual loss, GI bleeding).
map.铁蛋白「正常」还能是缺铁吗？: Can Ferritin Still Be "Normal" in Iron Deficiency?
map.能。感染、肿瘤、肝病可使铁蛋白假性升高；此时看 TSAT（<20% 提示可利用铁: Yes. Infection, tumors and liver disease can raise ferritin falsely; at those times TSAT (<20% suggests insufficient available iron) or stainable iron (bone marrow) is more reliable. Anemia of chronic disease and iron deficiency can coexist, so judge holistically.
map.网织红细胞高一定是溶血吗？: Does a High Reticulocyte Count Always Mean Hemolysis?
map.不一定。溶血、失血后恢复、治疗后（如补铁/EPO）网织均可升高；需结合 LDH、: Not always. Hemolysis, recovery after blood loss, and treatment (such as iron or EPO) can all raise the reticulocyte count; distinguish hemolysis from other causes with LDH, bilirubin, haptoglobin and the Coombs test.
